summary: Safety hub: 911 steps from the Safety Manual, manual download, how to report an injury, the two yearly volunteer clearances, every form and handout by topic, and ballpark rules from the Safety Code.
blurb: Safety in one place: emergency steps, how to report an injury, and every form.

sources.fact: Little League Abuse Awareness Training is required for all volunteers in addition to the background check, valid for the year; use the email you registered with (course link).
Background checks run through JDP, Little League's approved provider; JDP emails the volunteer, who must answer before the check begins.
Volunteers' background checks are emailed automatically by JDP; also complete Abuse Awareness Training with the same email.
